title: DSRL camera shutter opening and closing
notes: Extreme close-up of a camera lens iris slowly opening in the dark, like an eye/lens watching -> 'is someone watching only my account?'. Strong round shape and dark frame suit the 4/4 centred text. No people, no faces; only out-of-focus coloured screen reflections inside the lens, no readable text or logos (checked 1080p frames at 0.3, 4.5, 6.8 s). Dark. Native-speed continuous shot.

backup.title: Black cat with yellow eyes
backup.why: Black cat's yellow eyes glowing in darkness ('being watched'); very dark; eyes visible ~0.7-8.5 s; Free.

title: Numbers in a nixie tube counter
notes: Orange nixie-tube digits flickering through random numbers like constantly changing quotes, on a dark background; static close shot. Only digits (a row of printed scale numbers below), no words, brands or people. Dark, warm glow. Clip is short (5.8 s) but 0.3-5.34 is one continuous shot with no fade (checked).

backup.title: Number countdown
backup.why: Nixie tubes counting digits (6.0 s, fits 5.04 s); brighter backlit background; Free.

title: Water drops creating ripples
notes: Water surface after a splash settling into gentle, slow ripples - from agitated to calm, matching 'less shaken by regret'. Native slow-motion footage played at 1.0. No people, no text. Bright (light grey water) - renderer darkening needed.

backup.title: Single drops of water create ripples
backup.why: Single slow-motion drops making ripples that spread and fade; bright grey; Free.

title: Programmer using his cell phone while working at his desk
notes: A man's hands (no face) holding a phone above a dim RGB-lit keyboard, thumbs hovering and tapping - the moment of decision on the phone. Blue-purple low light, fits the channel look. Phone screen is dark/unreadable in this span. A small 'CORSAIR' brand mark on the keyboard edge moves within the blur box (verified at 3.0, 6.3, 9.7 s). Red toy figure at top right is generic, no logo. Replaces 4915 (banned).

backup.title: Person on social media while serving coffee
backup.why: A hand scrolling a phone while coffee is poured (hand only, looks male); bright; social-feed thumbnails on screen are small; Free.

title: Reverse tour of a library full of books
notes: Slow backward dolly through an empty library (shelves, reading tables, chairs) - transition into the research part. No people. Small Spanish shelf signs (e.g. 'TECNOLOGIA 600', 'SILENCIO') stay in the top band, covered by the blur box; book spines are not readable. Bright daylight window - renderer darkening needed (bright). Replaces 21587 (banned).

backup.title: A stack of different types of books
backup.why: Tall stack of old books in front of bookshelves, warm and dim, slow move; note: a book cover reading 'Duende' appears at the right edge from ~3 s and shelf labels 'Novela' early - would need a blur box; Free.

title: Man working on his laptop
notes: A man's hand on a laptop trackpad; the screen shows a dashboard with rising line charts (pink/red lines - reads as 'up' in Korea) and a table with small green/red cells; dim office by a window, slow drift. For 4/4 centred text the background is blurred, so screen text is unreadable; the MacBook label and macOS dock icons are additionally covered by the blur box (laptop barely moves 2-9.2 s); top menu/tab text and a small spreadsheet icon remain but are blurred by the centred-text treatment. Medium brightness. Chosen over 42665 (woman viewing charts) because of the male-protagonist rule.

backup.title: Decibel monitor
backup.why: Green LED level-meter bars bouncing like a live board; from 12 s the 'dBfs/dB' labels are out of frame (only digits); bright; Free.

title: Digital animation of screens
notes: Dark wall of dozens of small flickering screens (glitches, colour bars, film-leader countdown numbers) - an overwhelming number of things to compare. No people, no brands. The legible film-leader words ('SIX', 'NINE', 'ELEV...') sit in the left cluster, covered by the blur box; a couple of tiny leader words elsewhere remain (generic, very small). No Free stock-ticker clip without company names exists (4128 shows real company names; chart clips are Restricted). Dark.

backup.title: A laptop and four screens running green text scripts
backup.why: Four monitors and a laptop scrolling tiny green text with a slow push-in; note faint 'ACCESS G...' letters on the back wall in the first ~1.5 s and tiny monitor logos; Free.

title: Student makes a note over wooden desk filled with mathematical books and a calculator
notes: Overhead view of a desk covered with open books, notes, a calculator and a lamp; a young man (curly hair, head down - no face from 2 s on) works through the material - 'Odean looked into this too'. Book text too small to read. Warm, medium-bright. Note: same shoot as 50110/50113 used in an earlier video, but a different clip.

backup.title: The hands of a man taking notes with a pen on a cafe table with a black coffee cup in the back
backup.why: A man's hands taking notes with a pen at a cafe table; bright daylight; small logo on a closed notebook at left would need a blur box; Free.

title: People in the subway hall in Tokyo
notes: Commuters, mostly office workers, walking away from the camera down an underground passage - backs, distant faces small; static camera, normal speed. Small Japanese direction signs at the far end are covered by the blur box (static). Fluorescent, medium brightness. Chosen over 3433 (night-street time-lapse look is already in use).

backup.title: Crowds of people cross a street junction
backup.why: High-angle Shibuya crossing with crowds moving in all directions; tiny faces; daytime, bright; some distant signage; Free.

title: Stage of an electronic music festival
notes: Huge blazing stage screens at a night festival with the crowd's backs all facing the light - attention pulled to whatever shines brightest. No readable text or logos on the screens in this span (checked 1.0, 6.0, 7.0 s); crowd seen from behind, faces not distinguishable. Very bright orange-red - renderer darkening needed (very bright). Smoke grows after ~10 s.

backup.title: Lights and neon of a sign at Las Vegas
backup.why: Close-up of chasing marquee bulbs (gold) with a red element; no letters in checked frames; very bright; Free.

title: Young man from behind reading newspaper
notes: A man seen over the shoulder/from behind (glasses, eyes down on the paper, not looking at camera) reading a newspaper in warm low light - 'the news'. Newspaper text and a small ad mark would be readable when sharp, but the 3/3 centred text blurs the background. Chosen over 41201 (a woman's hand on a tablet chart) because of the male-protagonist rule.

backup.title: POV flipping through a newspaper
backup.why: POV hands flipping a newspaper ('EMPRESAS' headline readable when sharp; background is blurred under centred text); Free.

title: Dancer in the dark back view
notes: A man's silhouette under a single spotlight in darkness; the light slowly brightens onto his back - 'the one that stands out'. Back view only, no face (he turns his head ~8.8 s and starts dancing ~9.6 s, both after the span). Dark.

backup.title: Dancer silhouette
backup.why: Man's silhouette in a dark warehouse with light beams through windows; starts moving after ~6 s; Free.
